reading.action: I go all in, forging forward with all the skill and care I can to use my hottest flames against the hardest foe

r1_denTransit.mode: blind burning spin-advance, wet down-slope (deep den)
r1_denTransit.band: CLEAN — no stumble, no cost beyond planned drain

r2_allOutSalt.mode: all-out controlled flame-salt of the seat-room (reveal)
r2_allOutSalt.band: NAT-20 CRIT — total reveal: every woven figure reads as nothing to his heat-sense; the ONE real body flinches; crit color = he feels the whole weave pull taut back to the loom

r3_trueStrike.gate: x3 confirmed true-Host strike, UNMITIGATED per flare rule
r3_trueStrike.outcome: CRACK — by design does not kill (kill it twice); PHASE 2 TRIGGERED

reading.result: ALL-IN FORGE-FORWARD, DEN + SEAT IN ONE DRIVE. (1) Den transit CLEAN (margin 17): blind burning wheel down the wet slope; den figures are projections — flame lands on nothing, no den encounter by ground truth; he navigates by the thickness of the comfort-press (WILL reads it foreign) + the slope. MIDDEN CACHE MISSED (not searching — real water + journal + phase-3 stair warning all unfound; consequences stand). (2) At the seat the Host splits 5→7 (he HEARS the multiplication, eyes shut). His all-in hottest-flames = functionally the designed Ember-flare solve, arrived by temperament not the note (never read hall note). Intent 7 (exploits the TRUE lens-read: the floor is woven light; real fire is the honest instrument). NAT-20 salt = perfect reveal; the one real body marked unambiguously by heat-on-flesh + late weight + real dust. (3) True strike margin 52.5 x3 = 316 vs 144 — CRACKS the weaver: THIS ROOM's gold dies to real cold stone (per design phase-2 trigger; full-haven collapse is phase 3, held dark). PHASE 2 LIVE: true form risen (Init 33 — acts BEFORE Alan at t84), Alan deep-spent (focus 65), maul core SPENT hollow. Beat ends on it coming — situation, no choice assumed. COSTS: focus 110→65 (-10 chain sustain, -30 all-out salt, -5 strike surge), stamina 60→44 (-16), HP 118 unchanged (no counter — he struck true first try). PROGRESSION: Ember Burst 6→10 (EWMA α=0.5 vs J-anchor 15; JOURNEYMAN DEMO 1/2 BANKED — clean max-output live boss-pressure use, controlled, nat-20, no backlash), Chain Whip 1→2 (sustained live use), Ember Manipulation 7→8 (+1 major deliberate shaping event, 1st this encounter). NO card (no rung/tier/level change). HELD DARK protected: no Host/decoy/phase named; no shadow-recloak or stair foreshadow; loop untouched. Ch5 OPEN. NO Tower reset.
